attempt.reason: Batched functional requests from lin, sol.

args.name: Prepare locally gathered hazelnuts for food
args.function: Provide a feasible way to prepare gathered hazelnuts into edible food, including necessary safety checks and processing.
args.conditions: A visible hazelnut plant at (15.4,14.5) shows five units. I have not gathered or tested hazelnuts. My personally established food properties currently cover berries only.
args.inputs: Locally gathered hazelnuts; identify any necessary tools or additional materials rather than assuming I possess them.
args.costs: Unknown; specify time, effort, materials, and learning requirements.
args.effects: Enable actual preparation and testing of food. The request itself produces no food, mastery, or wellbeing benefit.

args.name: Observational drawing
args.function: Make a simple visible drawing from direct observation of a nearby natural subject, using an actually suitable surface and available materials.
args.conditions: I am outdoors on ordinary soil near a visible berry plant. I have no drawing tools or established drawing skill. Surface suitability and a workable method remain unknown.
args.inputs: An observed subject; suitable surface and any implement or marking material required by the reviewed method. None should be presumed owned.
args.costs: Method, learning time, effort and material costs are unknown; specify a feasible modest practice.
args.effects: If feasible and successfully performed, leave an actual simple drawing that can be inspected. Do not presume beauty, satisfaction, skill mastery or any reward merely from requesting it.

candidates.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
candidates.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
candidates.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

candidates.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
candidates.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
candidates.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.
Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

candidates.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

candidates.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
candidates.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack.

packet.access: Search or retrieve only this experiment abilities with control queries. Missing candidates do not prove a function absent. Full implementation facts remain available in the development handoff; never grant inventory or individual mastery. Require actual physical prerequisites.
